## Rules

| id | rule | kinds | Sutra source | enforced by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FR-1 | index.html is a body fragment, not a document. The server prepends charset, colour-scheme, the token sheet and the theme script, then the file verbatim. | page | modules_api.py page_html | C33 |
| FR-2 | Every control is a real button, a[href], input, select or textarea in reading order, with an accessible name, reachable by Tab, with a visible focus ring. No click handler on a div. | page | APPS-DESIGN.md controls; qa-shell/apps-a11y-check.mjs | C34 |
| FR-3 | The page cannot remember anything. On the opaque origin localStorage, sessionStorage, indexedDB and document.cookie throw; responses are no-store; the frame reloads on theme switch. Durable state lives in the file. | page | static/js/18-modules.js sandbox and frame nonce; modules_api.py Cache-Control no-store; 2026-09-08-modules-design.md | C35; C37 forces the answer to be one of the two honest options |
| FR-4 | Fit the pane, not a monitor: roughly 260px of usable width at the worst. | page | static/panel.css pane widths; modules_api.py body padding | C16 |
| FR-5 | A page ships only when it has been rendered in both themes with no console errors. When no headless runtime is available the record says render: not run and the run is incomplete, never a pass. | page | qa-shell/apps-check.mjs (raw CDP lane); modules_api.py page_html | C36 plus exit code 3 |
| FR-6 | A link's whole surface is its row: name, tagline, and the Open control that appears only when the screen resolves. The Frontend row of a link's record reads n-a (link). | link | modules_api.py link surface; static/js/18-modules.js modLinkOpenable | C3 and C32; no separate link branch of C36 |
| FR-7 | A chat has nothing to render. Its surface is one string, and every chat verdict in this kit is a static read of that string. | chat | static/js/18-modules.js modAppBodyHtml chat branch | C36 reports n/a for chat and the runner prints that line |

## Checks

| id | level | kinds | v1 | what | evaluator |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| C33 | kind-required | page | must-fix | index.html is a body fragment with one root element carrying lang, inline style and script only. | HTMLParser census FAILs on a doctype, <html, <head, <body, <frameset, any <script src=, any <link tag; FAILs when no element carries lang=; WARNs on more than one top-level element |
| C34 | kind-required | page | suggest | Every control is a real control with an accessible name. | FAIL on onclick/onkeydown on a div or span, role=button without tabindex, img without alt, tabindex above 0, outline:none with no :focus-visible rule; accessible name resolved from text, aria-label, title, aria-labelledby; unresolvable statically is WARN; render clause advisory |
| C35 | kind-required | page | must-fix | The page does not try to store anything. | FAIL on localStorage, sessionStorage, indexedDB, document.cookie, caches., navigator.storage, Notification, requestPermission; dynamic property access is not caught and the check text says so |
| C36 | required | page | must-fix | The page renders in both themes with a non-empty body and no console errors. | headless Chrome over raw CDP (the qa-shell/apps-check.mjs lane): navigate to /api/modules/<id>/page?theme=dark then light, assert zero exceptions, zero console errors, zero failed loads, body text non-empty; no runtime reachable reports skip, writes render: not run and exits 3 unless --allow-skip-render; chat and link read n/a; the desktop's own run_checks pins the skip (no render inside a request), so this check bites in check.py and sutra_app_check, the lanes run before done |
| C37 | kind-required | page | must-fix | The F2 answer is one of the two honest options. | the cell's first phrase, normalized, is 'resets each time' or 'baked into the file'; anything else FAILs with both options quoted |
